externalCandidateReview.head: e67ce4e41019c5bf29eb3b5c3dd634f28d3e17e1
externalCandidateReview.reason: The candidate classifies internal traffic from a fixed text-prefix list, which contradicts the requirement that text alone must never determine internal provenance. It also fails independent marker-text regression coverage and its lint gate.

findings.title: Synthetic FlowDeck prompt transported as a user-role message increments user authority after Stop

reproduction.preFixObserved: Expected durable user turn version 2 after genuine Stop; received 3 after a synthetic specialist-dispatch event.

rootCause.detail: onChatMessage incremented SessionTurnRepository before semantic provenance was established, so every non-empty Heidi/orchestrator message was treated as a genuine user turn.

findings.impact: An internally generated prompt could re-enter ordinary routing after Stop and create new autonomous authority.
findings.repair: V16 persists FlowDeck-owned OpenCode message IDs and their provenance. ContinuationDispatcher passes a reserved messageID to promptAsync and invokes a final pre-native reservation hook. The adapter suppresses a message only when that durable session/message-ID association exists; raw text and role never determine provenance.

findings.title: FDX strict Clippy gate fails on needless explicit lifetimes and an empty documentation line

rootCause.detail: Clippy detected unnecessary explicit lifetimes and an empty line following a documentation comment.

findings.impact: The required native FDX static-analysis gate could not pass.
findings.repair: Elided the two inferable lifetimes and removed the empty documentation line without changing behavior.

findings.title: FDX self-test recursively launched unbounded cargo test processes

reproduction.preFixObserved: The test_test_cargo integration test invoked fdx test cargo from the FDX crate, which recursively launched its own integration suite and exhausted sandbox memory.

rootCause.detail: The Cargo wrapper inherited no recursion sentinel, so the wrapper's own integration test could re-enter the same cargo test command indefinitely.

findings.impact: A local FDX self-test or direct fdx test cargo invocation from the FDX checkout could consume unbounded processes and memory.
findings.repair: The Cargo wrapper now propagates FDX_TEST_RUNNER_ACTIVE to its child cargo test and rejects a nested wrapper invocation before process launch.
